title: Clearer code. Smoother writing.
summary: Better code blocks, clearer note-card previews, and update controls that respect your workspace preferences.

items: Add multiline code with the new Code block toolbar button. Selecting multiple lines with Inline code now creates a code block too.
Code in note-card previews has distinct styling, with better alignment after numbered lists.
What’s New uses a themed version selector, and automatic update controls have a custom checkbox and clearer spacing.
Automatic update checks are off by default for offline profiles. Enabling them explains the internet connection and information involved.
Automatic update preferences are saved separately for each workspace.
Numbered lists keep their written numbers when separated by paragraphs or code blocks, including after syncing.
Multiline code preserves indentation and literal Markdown when previewed or synced.
Code blocks created with backticks attached to the code are recognized without swallowing later list items.
The new-note editor scrolls to keep the line you are typing visible.
Unavailable public update information is explained clearly instead of always appearing as a connection error.
